18403 / 18404 Bhubaneswar–Dhanbad Express is a daily Mail/Express train of the Indian Railways operated by the East Coast Railway zone. It connects  in the Indian state of Odisha with  in Jharkhand.
Prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, direct connectivity between Bhubaneswar and Dhanbad was provided by the 12832 / 12831 Bhubaneswar–Dhanbad Garib Rath Express. The service was discontinued during the pandemic. Subsequently, a Special Fare Special train numbered 02832 / 02831 was introduced on 22 August 2022 to restore connectivity on the route. This special service was later regularised as the 18403 / 18404 Bhubaneswar–Dhanbad Express with effect from 1 April 2026.
History
Prior to the COVID-19 pandemic, direct rail connectivity between Bhubaneswar and Dhanbad was provided by the 12832 / 12831 Bhubaneswar–Dhanbad Garib Rath Express. The service was discontinued during the nationwide suspension of passenger train operations in 2020.
In order to restore connectivity on the route, Indian Railways introduced the 02832 / 02831 Bhubaneswar–Dhanbad Special Fare Special with effect from 22 August 2022. The train continued to operate as a special service to cater to passenger demand between Odisha and Jharkhand.
Subsequently, the service was regularised as a permanent daily Mail/Express train with new numbers 18403 / 18404 Bhubaneswar–Dhanbad Express with effect from 1 April 2026.
Service
The train runs daily in both directions covering a distance of about 780 kilometres. It takes approximately 14 hours and 30 minutes to complete its journey with an average speed of around 48–54 km/h.

Timings
18403 Bhubaneswar–Dhanbad Express
* Departs Bhubaneswar at 20:25 hrs
* Arrives Dhanbad at 11:00 hrs (next day)
18404 Dhanbad–Bhubaneswar Express
* Departs Dhanbad at 16:00 hrs
* Arrives Bhubaneswar at 08:15 hrs (next day)
Rake composition
The train generally runs with ICF coachesconsisting of AC 2 Tier, AC 3 Tier, Sleeper Class and General Unreserved coaches along with SLR coaches. The train operates with electric locomotives throughout its fully electrified route.
Importance
The train provides an important direct rail link between the industrial and coal belt regions of Odisha and Jharkhand. It is widely used by daily travellers, students, migrant workers and business passengers.
